## Summary

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Related issue

Link the issue, or write "None".

## How to test and results

List the steps or commands run and their results. Identify checks that were not run and explain why.

## Screenshots

Add screenshots for interface changes, or write "Not applicable".

## Database migrations or environment changes

Describe migrations, local data impact, environment variable names and setup steps, or write "Not applicable". Never include credentials or real personal data.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The base branch is correct: feature branches target develop; releases target production.
- [ ] The change is scoped and follows AGENTS.md conventions.
- [ ] Relevant checks passed; unverified checks and limitations are documented.
- [ ] Documentation and tests reflect the resulting behavior where relevant.
- [ ] Migration and environment changes are documented where relevant; applied migrations are unchanged.
- [ ] No credentials or real personal data are included.
